about: C3 4th owner: the shunt (rules.js RAM) by real input. From the river road's checkpoint, the gun dry and his right rear tyre already gone (set up as a round would leave it: the game's state, not the hands), the hands ('pitter' in src/scenes/tail/bot.js: up beside his back quarter on the other lane's side, then the wheel into it) shunt him: he goes off the road (C._ramWin). A straight bump from behind never does (the critic's tools/plays/critic/c3c2_drive.mjs 'ram one'). The teach card for the dry gun is read from the kit. NOIR_PORT=5343 node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/tail_shunt.json --size 1440x900

steps.eval: (() => { const C = G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase; C.gun.rounds = 0; C.gun.pocket = 0; C.hisDmg = { tyres: 1, man: 0, tank: 0, body: 0, rims: 0, nick: { rr: 1 }, nicks: 1 }; C.his.grip.rr = 0.32; C.his.flat = { rr: 1 }; C.driver.pace *= 0.88; C.driver.control = 0.72; window.__tailFails = []; window.__c3tries = 0; return 'dry, his right rear gone'; })()

shots.s02_beside_his_quarter: !!G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase && (() => { const C = G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase; const l = C.his.local(C.my.pos); return Math.abs(l.x + 3.6) < 1.6 && Math.abs(l.z + 2.4) < 1.1; })()

steps.eval: JSON.stringify({ phase: G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase.phase, ramWin: !!G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase._ramWin, lastRam: G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase.lastRam, fails: (window.__tailFails || []).map((f) => f.why) })
